title: Finance Dashboard
feeRemindersSubtitle: Configure automatic WhatsApp reminders for overdue fee payments. The system runs nightly and sends messages based on these rules.
outstandingSubtitle: Unpaid balances sit here until someone collects. Download each invoice before the term moves on — or remove one that was raised by mistake.
noOutstandingDesc: Every open invoice is paid. Create invoices or wait for new term bills if this looks empty by mistake.
pleaseSettleDebt: Please settle this balance with the school office. Bring this notice when you pay.
invoiceDocumentFooter: This invoice shows the fee balance due for school records and payment.
remindersGracePeriod: Grace period: {days} days · Runs nightly via /api/cron/fee-reminders
cashAvailableHint: Fees collected - payroll paid - operating expenses
dashboardBudgetSubtitle: Planned spending for the school year — separate from cash already spent.
dashboardBudgetEmpty: No yearly budget plan yet. Create one to track planned spending before it becomes ad-hoc expenses.
dashboardBudgetLines: {count, plural, one {# line item} other {# line items}}
deleteInvoiceConfirm: Delete this invoice? Linked payments may be removed.
assignSchoolInvoices: Assign a school to your profile to create and manage invoices.
noStudentsForInvoices: No active students in this school yet. Onboard students in Academic before invoicing.
searchStudentsPlaceholder: Search by name, ID, or class
billAllStudentsHint: Uses the fee structure amount. If the structure is class-linked, only that class is billed.
billAllNeedsFeeStructure: Pick a fee structure to bill all students
assignBranchFeeStructure: Assign a school to your profile to manage fee structures.
assignSchoolFeeStructure: Assign a school to your profile to manage fee structures.
noFeeStructuresDesc: Without fee templates, invoices can't be raised and parents have nothing to pay—define tuition here.
noInvoicesDesc: Every day without invoices, parents can't see or pay balances—create fee structures and generate invoices
noPaymentsDesc: Unrecorded payments become disputes at the gate—log a payment against an open invoice.
generatePayrollDesc: Create pending payroll for everyone still ticked in for this month (skips people you excluded).
addStaffHint: Set pay amounts for all staff above in Finance. You can still add non-account staff in Operations.
noPayrollDesc: Staff wait while payroll lives in a spreadsheet—generate this period or add an entry.
assignBranchExpenses: Assign a branch to your profile to record expenses.
noExpensesDesc: Untracked spending becomes an end-of-term surprise—log the next expense for approval.
expensesApprovalHint: New expenses create an academic admin task. Approved finance expenses issue a printable receipt.
receiptUnavailableDesc: A receipt is issued only after the academic admin approves this finance expense.
receiptFooter: This receipt confirms an approved school expense for finance records.
noInvoiceChartData: No invoice data to chart yet.
currencyDescription: Choose the currency shown on fees, expenses, payroll, and parent payment screens. Defaults to US Dollars.
noSchoolLinkedDesc: Your account is not linked to a school yet.
budgetSubtitle: Plan school spending by category and period, then export a branded PDF for investors.
confirmDeleteBudgetPlan: Delete this budget plan and all line items?
noBudgetPlansDesc: Create a yearly plan to organize planned spending before it turns into ad-hoc expense requests.
noBudgetLines: No line items yet. Add planned spending below.
budgetReportFooter: This yearly budget plan is prepared by finance for school leadership and investors.
remindersDisabledHint: When disabled, no WhatsApp messages will be sent by the cron job.
gracePeriodHint: After this many days, the final warning is sent and the student may be barred.
noPayrollThisMonth: No payroll records for this month yet.
payrollMarkPaidFailed: Failed to mark payroll as paid
excludeFromPayrollConfirm: Exclude {name} from this month''s payroll? They will not be paid unless you tick them back in.
generatePayrollHint: Tick people out in Staff pay amounts for this month before generating. Payroll only includes people still checked in.
staffPayAmountsHint: Set how much each person should be paid, then tick out anyone finance should skip for {month}. Generate payroll after amounts and inclusions are set.
noStaffOnRoster: No staff on the payroll roster yet. Click Refresh staff roster to pull the school team, or add people in Operations.
payrollSearchPlaceholder: Name, staff ID, position, department, status
paymentProofHint: Optional. Upload a receipt or transfer screenshot, or take a photo with your camera.
assignSchoolForProof: Assign a school to your profile to attach payment proof.
expenseSubmitted: Expense submitted for academic admin approval
remindDaysBefore: Remind X days before due date
remindDaysBeforeHint: Comma-separated list. E.g. "3, 1" sends a reminder 3 days before and 1 day before due date.
remindOnDueDate: Send reminder on the due date itself
remindOnGraceExpiry: Send final warning when grace period expires
remindOnGraceExpiryHint: This is the 'do not bring student to school' message
standardReminderHint: Used for reminders before or on the due date.
finalWarningHint: Sent when grace period expires. Should clearly state the student should not come to school.
deletePayrollConfirmDesc: This will remove every payroll record for the selected month.
